reason: The port fulfills the page's own paused response at the response phase, which Strider does on Chromium only: Firefox can't fulfill at that phase (interception.responseFulfill), and WebKit can't read a paused response's body (interception.responseBody, CDP only) nor change its headers (interception.responseHeaders).
